name: game-standalone-views
goal: Generated 2D and 3D games follow authored view transitions and restore per-view checkpoint progress.

evidence: The generated page binds document.views[0] permanently; transition actions change state.view but the UI never enters that view. The engine and authoring workspace already support enterView progress restoration.

The CLI matrix fetched SSR HTML only, and standalone image acceptance played one view. Extend those existing cases to run the browser against generated source and bundled CLI projects, enter a second view and return with the first checkpoint image restored.

Unchanged source and bundled 2D/3D browser cases fail at a81ac7026: checkpoint transitions must enter the target view. Inspected capture still shows The courtyard after collecting the key and requesting second view.
Use existing enterView to resolve checkpoint transition targets immediately, rerender the selected view and restore its own completed checkpoints.

All five CLI cases pass at cb760ee2c: source and bundled CLI in both dimensions play a transition to Second chamber, return to The courtyard and restore the saved checkpoint image. Inspected matching transition screenshot shows Second chamber and a fully rendered scene.
